front.title: Signed Digest Manifests for Multicast Datagram Authentication

abstract.t: This document defines a format for authenticating UDP datagrams delivered over IP multicast without changing them. The sender computes a digest over every data datagram of a flow, places the digests of up to 37 datagrams in a fixed-layout record, signs the record with Ed25519 under a prefix that names the flow, and sends it in band, on the flow's own source, group and port, immediately before the datagrams it covers, followed by a byte-identical twin. Every record begins with four fixed octets, and no data datagram does, so a receiver tells records from data by those octets alone. A receiver verifies one signature per record, hashes each datagram once, and delivers a datagram only after its digest matches an entry of a verified record; it needs no return channel. A well-known document supplies a flow's keys and parameters. A Media over QUIC profile and a browser profile use the format.
